items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I went with Stuffy Smith and played Chicago, and after Chicago I went with Stuff Smith to Hollywood, and played the Treuville Club

ctx.x: So it had been a long time you hadn't been with him.

Yeah, it's been quite a while there. Because before that, before -- after I left, I went with Stuffy Smith and played Chicago, and after Chicago I went with Stuff Smith to Hollywood, and played the Treuville Club, and at that time Fats was moving. John Hamilton, Bugs was with Fats. They played the hotel in Chicago -- (Snap).
